# Introduction

In this section we will illustrate how specific designs, e.g. 

- two-way anova designs
- block designs 

can be analysed using the general linear model. 

# Two-way anova 

## Data 


48 rats were allocated to 

- 3 poisons (I,II,III) and 
- 4 treatments (A,B,C,D). 


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
library(faraway)
data(rats)

library(GGally)
rats |>
  ggpairs()
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](10-SpecificDesigns_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-1-1.png){width=672}
:::
:::



We have a design with a continuous response time (survival) and two factors: 

- Poison: I, II, III
- Treatment: A, B, C, D

The data exploration indicates that there seems to be an effect of both treatment and poison.
